activities.subject: English
activities.guide: Help the child look around the room. Play a game: 'I spy with my little eye a naming word (noun) starting with P.' Name people, places, animals, and things.
activities.interactiveQuestion: Can you name 3 things in this room, 2 animals, and 1 place you love to go? Are all these naming words?
activities.funTask: 🎒 Put 5 random toys/items on the table and ask the child to classify them into 'Person' (toys), 'Place' (draw a house), 'Animal', or 'Thing'.

activities.subject: Mathematics
activities.guide: Compare household items. Use a large bowl and a small spoon. Use objects close to you versus things far away.
activities.interactiveQuestion: Look at the refrigerator and this glass. Which one is bigger? Look at the window. Is it near us or far away?
activities.funTask: 🚶 Stand near the child, then walk to the door. Ask the child to say 'Near' or 'Far' based on your position.

activities.subject: EVS
activities.guide: Look in the mirror together. Touch and identify forehead, cheeks, chin, shoulders, elbows, and knees.
activities.interactiveQuestion: Point to your elbows. What do they help you do? Point to your knees. Can you bend them?
activities.funTask: 💃 Play 'Simon Says' touching different body parts. E.g., 'Simon says touch your shoulders, Simon says blink your eyes!'

activities.subject: Kannada
activities.guide: Sing simple Kannada alphabet rhymes or practice writing the strokes of 'ಅ' (a) and 'ಆ' (aa).
activities.interactiveQuestion: What is the first letter of Kannada Swaragalu? Can you trace the shape of 'ಅ' in the air?
activities.funTask: 🎨 Draw the letter 'ಅ' on a paper and let your child paint/color it.

activities.subject: English
activities.guide: Recite the poem together with full actions. Clapping hands, patting knees, stamping feet, blinking eyes.
activities.interactiveQuestion: Can you show me what actions you do in the poem when you are happy? What is the spelling of 'Happy'?
activities.funTask: 🎭 Act out different emotions: Happy (smile & clap), Sad (frown), Angry (cross arms), Excited (jump)!

activities.subject: Mathematics
activities.guide: Use rajma beans, matchsticks, or pencils to count up to 10. Practice backward counting from 10 to 0.
activities.interactiveQuestion: If I give you 3 pencils and add 2 more, how many do you have? Let's count backward: 10, 9, 8...
activities.funTask: ✏️ Pencil activity: Make groups of tens and ones using pencils bound together with a rubber band.

activities.subject: EVS
activities.guide: Explain the 5 sense organs (Eyes, Ears, Nose, Tongue, Skin). Play the sensory guessing game.
activities.interactiveQuestion: Which sense organ helps you taste an ice cream? Which one helps you hear your favourite song?
activities.funTask: 🙈 Blindfold Game: Blindfold the child and have them touch an object (e.g. soft toy) or smell a fruit, then guess what it is!

activities.subject: Hindi
activities.guide: Identify pictures starting with व्यंजन (क से कबूतर, ख से खरगोश). Practice tracing the letters.
activities.interactiveQuestion: Which letter comes after 'क'? Can you name a fruit starting with 'अ' (अ से अनार)?
activities.funTask: 🌳 व्यंजन का पेड़ (Consonant Tree): Draw a tree and place leaf cutouts with Hindi letters on it.

activities.subject: Computer Science
activities.guide: Identify CPU, Monitor, Keyboard, Mouse. Compare a computer to human body parts.
activities.interactiveQuestion: What is the brain of the computer called? What do we use to type words on a screen?
activities.funTask: 💻 Draw a simple computer monitor, keyboard, and mouse, and write your child's name inside the screen.

activities.subject: English
activities.guide: Talk about family members (Father, Mother, Sister, Brother, Grandparents). Introduce your family relationships.
activities.interactiveQuestion: Who is the oldest member of our family? What is your father's / mother's name?
activities.funTask: 🎨 Draw a Family Tree on an A4 sheet. Paste small photos or draw faces of family members.

activities.subject: English
activities.guide: Explain that naming words can be sorted into Common names (boy, dog) and Special names (Rahul, Bruno).
activities.interactiveQuestion: Is 'pencil' a common name or a special name? What about your name?
activities.funTask: 📝 Write 3 common nouns and 3 proper nouns on flashcards and ask the child to sort them.

activities.subject: Mathematics
activities.guide: Use a box and toys to demonstrate inside/outside. Point to the top of a shelf and bottom of a shelf.
activities.interactiveQuestion: Are your toys inside the basket or outside? Put the book on the top shelf.
activities.funTask: 🏀 Draw a circle on the floor. Play 'In and Out': child jumps inside when you say 'Inside' and outside when you say 'Outside'.

activities.subject: EVS
activities.guide: Help the child practice speaking 5 lines about themselves: name, age, class, school, and favourite activity.
activities.interactiveQuestion: Can you introduce yourself to me in English? What is your favourite sport?
activities.funTask: 🎤 Play 'Press Interview': Use a dummy mic and interview your child about their likes and dislikes.

activities.subject: Kannada
activities.guide: Practice writing and identifying the strokes of Kannada consonants: ಕ, ಖ, ಗ, ಘ, ಙ.
activities.interactiveQuestion: Which Kannada letter stands for 'ಕಮಲ' (Lotus)? Can you pronounce 'ಗ'?
activities.funTask: ✏️ Clay modeling: Use playdough to mold the shapes of Kannada letters 'ಕ' and 'ಗ'.

activities.subject: English
activities.guide: Sing the 'Family Song' together using finger puppets. Draw faces of family members on fingers using sketch pens.
activities.interactiveQuestion: Can you name all the fingers in the family song? (Father finger, Mother finger...)
activities.funTask: 🎭 Finger puppet play: Act out a small conversation between the Father finger and Baby finger.

activities.subject: Mathematics
activities.guide: Count 20 spoons, crayons, or buttons. Show that 11 is '1 ten and 1 one', 12 is '1 ten and 2 ones', etc.
activities.interactiveQuestion: If we have one bundle of 10 pencils and 5 loose pencils, what number is it?
activities.funTask: ✏️ Bundle activity: Bind 10 ice cream sticks with a rubber band to represent a 'Ten', and use loose sticks to count up to 20.

activities.subject: EVS
activities.guide: Talk about healthy habits: brushing twice, bathing, exercising, drinking water, and sleeping early.
activities.interactiveQuestion: Why should we brush our teeth twice a day? How many hours of sleep do you need?
activities.funTask: 📋 Draw / paste pictures of 3 healthy foods and 3 healthy activities (e.g. running, sleeping) on a sheet.

activities.subject: Hindi
activities.guide: Learn to read and write the second line of consonants: च से चम्मच, छ से छतरी, ज से जहाज, झ से झंडा, ञ.
activities.interactiveQuestion: Which letter stands for 'छतरी' (umbrella)? Can you write 'ज'?
activities.funTask: 🎨 Letter tracing: Trace the letter 'झ' with seeds or pulses glued onto card paper.

focus: Computer Input Devices & English Naming Words

activities.subject: Computer Science
activities.guide: Explain the keyboard has keys to type, and the mouse has buttons to click. Compare keys to typewriter keys.
activities.interactiveQuestion: What button on the mouse do we click to select things? What do we use to type your name?
activities.funTask: ⌨️ Draw a large keyboard layout on cardboard and let the child pretend to 'type' spelling words on it.

activities.subject: English
activities.guide: Identify naming words in short sentences. Write simple sentences like 'The dog runs.' and point out the nouns.
activities.interactiveQuestion: In the sentence 'The cat sleeps on the mat', what are the naming words?
activities.funTask: 🔍 Noun Hunt: Read a short storybook page together and have your child circle all the naming words they find.

activities.subject: English
activities.guide: Explain that rhyming words sound similar at the end. E.g. happy/snappy, sad/bad, teddy/ready.
activities.interactiveQuestion: What rhymes with 'Happy'? What is a rhyming word for 'Cat'?
activities.funTask: 🌳 Rhyming Tree: Draw a tree and write rhyming words (e.g. log, dog, fog) on green leaf cutouts and paste them.

activities.subject: Mathematics
activities.guide: Place objects in a line to explain before, after, and between. Connect it to number sequences.
activities.interactiveQuestion: What number comes before 15? What number is between 11 and 13?
activities.funTask: 🏃 Hopscotch: Draw a grid with numbers 1 to 20. Ask your child to jump to the number that comes 'after 8' or 'before 15'.

activities.subject: EVS
activities.guide: Focus on the parts of the face: eyes, nose, ears, mouth, chin, forehead, cheeks.
activities.interactiveQuestion: Where are your cheeks? What part of your face is below your mouth?
activities.funTask: 🎨 Face drawing: Draw a circle outline and have the child draw and label eyes, eyebrows, nose, mouth, and ears.

activities.subject: Kannada
activities.guide: Practice writing the letters that come before and after given Kannada alphabets.
activities.interactiveQuestion: What Kannada letter comes after 'ಅ'? What comes before 'ಇ'?
activities.funTask: 🧩 Matching Cards: Write letters on cards. Have the child pair the consecutive letters (e.g. ಅ -> ಆ).

activities.subject: Hindi
activities.guide: Identify consonants from ट to म (ट से टमाटर, ठ से ठठेरा, ड से डमरू... त से तरबूज... प से पतंग... म से मछली).
activities.interactiveQuestion: Which Hindi letter represents 'मछلی' (Fish)? What is the starting letter of 'पतंग' (Kite)?
activities.funTask: 🌳 व्यंजन का पेड़ part 2: Add leaf cutouts with letters from ट to म on the consonant tree.

activities.subject: Mathematics
activities.guide: Reinforce place value. 15 is 1 Ten and 5 Ones. 20 is 2 Tens and 0 Ones.
activities.interactiveQuestion: If I have 18 crayons, how many groups of tens do I have? How many single ones are left over?
activities.funTask: 🍬 Use sweet treats or beans to make groups of 10. Let your child eat the 'ones' to understand subtraction!

activities.subject: EVS
activities.guide: Discuss what a child likes (favourite sports, foods, cartoon characters, toys).
activities.interactiveQuestion: Who is your favourite cartoon character? What is your favourite food to eat?
activities.funTask: 🐛 Draw a large caterpillar. In each body segment, paste a drawing or picture of your child's favourite sports, toy, and food.

activities.subject: Kannada
activities.guide: Read simple 2-letter Kannada words using Swaragalu and simple consonants (ಅಕ್ಷರಾಭ್ಯಾಸ ೧,೯). E.g. ಅರ, ಆಲ, ಕರ, ಗಜ.
activities.interactiveQuestion: Can you read the word 'ಅರ' (file)? How do you sound out 'ಆಲ' (Banyan tree)?
activities.funTask: 📖 Word tracing: Write simple 2-letter Kannada words in dotted lines and have the child trace and read them aloud.

activities.subject: Computer Science
activities.guide: Explain the difference: Hardware is what you can touch (monitor, keyboard), Software is inside (games, drawing paint).
activities.interactiveQuestion: Can you touch a computer game? Is a computer mouse hardware or software?
activities.funTask: 🖥️ Hardware activity: Cut out pictures from magazines of keyboard, monitor, printer, CPU, and sort them into a collage.

activities.subject: Hindi
activities.guide: Read two, three, and four-letter Hindi words without मात्रा (vowels). E.g. नल, घर, फल, मटर, कमल, बरगद, अचकन.
activities.interactiveQuestion: Can you combine 'न' and 'ल' to read the word? What does 'घर' mean?
activities.funTask: 🧩 Word Builder: Use alphabet cards to build simple Hindi words like 'फल' and 'मटर' and read them.
